name: spawn_agents_on_csv
description: Process a CSV by spawning one worker sub-agent per row. The instruction string is a template where `{column}` placeholders are replaced with row values. Each worker must call `report_agent_job_result` with a JSON object (matching `output_schema` when provided); missing reports are treated as failures. This call blocks until all rows finish and automatically exports results to `output_csv_path` (or a default path).

csv_path.description: Path to the CSV file containing input rows.

instruction.description: Instruction template to apply to each CSV row. Use {column_name} placeholders to inject values from the row.

id_column.description: Optional column name to use as stable item id.

output_csv_path.description: Optional output CSV path for exported results.

max_concurrency.description: Maximum concurrent workers for this job. Defaults to 16 and is capped by config.

max_workers.description: Alias for max_concurrency. Set to 1 to run sequentially.

max_runtime_seconds.description: Maximum runtime per worker before it is failed. Defaults to 1800 seconds.
